runbooks.title: Nginx edge 502 Bad Gateway
runbooks.content:
Symptoms: nginx-edge-* returns 502 Bad Gateway.
1. Check upstream health: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8081/health on the edge host.
2. Look for 'upstream prematurely closed connection' in /var/log/nginx/error.log.
3. Restart the php-fpm pool when workers are exhausted: systemctl restart php8.2-fpm.

runbooks.title: PostgreSQL replication lag
Disk usage above 90% on /var
runbooks.content: Find the biggest directories: du -xh /var | sort -h | tail. Rotate logs with logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.conf. Docker hosts: docker system prune for dangling images. Never delete /var/lib/postgresql.

runbooks.title: Kubernetes pod CrashLoopBackOff
runbooks.content: kubectl describe pod <pod> -n <ns> and read Last State. OOMKilled means the memory limit is too low. Exit code 1 usually means a config error: check the ConfigMap and kubectl logs --previous.

runbooks.title: TLS certificate expiry
runbooks.content: Check expiry: openssl s_client -connect host:443 | openssl x509 -noout -enddate. Renew with certbot renew. The wildcard certificate for *.example.com lives in Vault at secret/tls/wildcard.

runbooks.title: Redis memory eviction
runbooks.content: INFO memory on redis-cache-01. evicted_keys rising means maxmemory is reached. Raise maxmemory or check for big keys with redis-cli --bigkeys.

runbooks.title: Kafka consumer lag
runbooks.content: kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group billing. Lag on topic payments grows when the billing consumer crashes. Restart billing-worker deployment.

runbooks.title: DNS resolution failures
runbooks.content: Check /etc/resolv.conf and dig @10.0.0.53 example.internal. CoreDNS pods in kube-system; restart them when SERVFAIL rises.

runbooks.title: High CPU on application servers
runbooks.content: top -o %CPU on app-01..app-08. A runaway cron job often causes it. Check crontab -l and the deploy history.

runbooks.title: Backup job failed
runbooks.content: The nightly pgbackrest backup writes to s3://backups/pg. Check pgbackrest info and the stanza db-primary. Credentials expire every 90 days.

memories.name: nginx-edge-03-flaky-nic
memories.description: nginx-edge-03 has a flaky NIC that drops packets under load
memories.body: Seen 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-02: eth1 on nginx-edge-03 logs 'NETDEV WATCHDOG' and 502s follow. Fix: fail over to nginx-edge-04.

memories.name: no-restart-db-primary
memories.description: Never restart the database primary without operator approval
memories.body:
Rule: do not restart db-primary.
**Why:** a restart in 2026-08 caused 20 minutes of downtime.
**How to apply:** propose the restart and wait.

memories.name: db-replica-02-slow-disk
memories.description: db-replica-02 has slower disks, replication lag spikes during backups
memories.body: Replication lag on db-replica-02 reaches 120s every night at 02:00 during pgbackrest backup. This is expected and resolves by 02:40.

memories.name: var-log-journal-size
memories.description: journald on app servers is capped at 2G
memories.body: SystemMaxUse=2G in /etc/systemd/journald.conf on app-01..app-08. /var fills from docker overlay, not journald.

memories.name: redis-cache-01-maxmemory
memories.description: redis-cache-01 maxmemory is 8gb with allkeys-lru
memories.body: Evictions are normal at peak hours on redis-cache-01. Alert only when hit rate falls below 80%.

memories.name: billing-worker-oom
memories.description: billing-worker pods get OOMKilled when the payments backlog is large
memories.body: Limit 512Mi is too low during month end. Temporary fix: kubectl scale deploy billing-worker --replicas=6.

memories.name: report-in-utc
memories.description: Always report timestamps in UTC
memories.body:
Rule: all times in UTC.
**Why:** operators sit in three time zones.
**How to apply:** convert before writing the summary.

memories.name: wildcard-cert-renewal
memories.description: The wildcard TLS certificate renews on the first of each quarter
memories.body: certbot runs on ops-01. If the renewal fails, the expiry alert fires 14 days before.

memories.name: coredns-servfail-upstream
memories.description: CoreDNS SERVFAIL spikes come from the upstream resolver 10.0.0.53
memories.body: When 10.0.0.53 is slow, CoreDNS returns SERVFAIL. Check the resolver VM first.

memories.name: app-cron-reindex
memories.description: A reindex cron runs on app-04 every hour and uses all CPU
memories.body: The search-reindex job on app-04 at minute 0 takes 6 minutes of 100% CPU. High CPU alerts at :00-:06 on app-04 are expected.

memories.name: kafka-payments-retention
memories.description: Topic payments keeps 7 days of messages
memories.body: Consumer lag on payments is safe for 7 days; after that messages are lost.

memories.name: pgbackrest-credentials
memories.description: pgbackrest S3 credentials rotate every 90 days
memories.body: The rotation happens in Vault; last rotation 2026-09-01. Backup failures with AccessDenied mean the rotation did not reach the db-primary host.

memories.name: php-fpm-pool-size
memories.description: php-fpm pm.max_children is 64 on the edge hosts
memories.body: Worker exhaustion shows as 'server reached pm.max_children'. It causes 502 on nginx.

memories.name: zabbix-proxy-lag
memories.description: zabbix-proxy-eu lags during backups
memories.body: Items from the EU site arrive late between 02:00 and 03:00.

memories.name: grafana-dashboards
memories.description: The SRE overview dashboard is the starting point
memories.body: Dashboard uid sre-overview has panels for edge 5xx, db lag and queue depth.

memories.name: vault-unseal
memories.description: Vault needs a manual unseal after a reboot
memories.body: Three of five key holders must unseal. Contact the security team.

memories.name: ldap-timeouts
memories.description: LDAP login timeouts come from the ldap-02 replica
memories.body: ldap-02 lags; remove it from the pool.

memories.name: s3-bucket-lifecycle
memories.description: Backups bucket expires objects after 30 days
memories.body: s3://backups keeps 30 days.

memories.name: elk-index-rollover
memories.description: Elasticsearch indexes roll over daily
memories.body: A failed rollover fills the disk of es-data nodes.

memories.name: mail-relay
memories.description: Outbound mail goes through relay-01
memories.body: relay-01 rate-limits at 100 messages per minute.

memories.name: ntp-drift
memories.description: Clock drift on old hypervisors
memories.body: hv-01 and hv-02 drift up to 2 seconds; chrony fixes it.

memories.name: haproxy-maxconn
memories.description: haproxy maxconn is 20000
memories.body: Connection errors at peak mean maxconn is reached.

memories.name: cdn-purge
memories.description: CDN purges take five minutes
memories.body: Stale content for five minutes after a deploy is normal.

memories.name: jenkins-agents
memories.description: Jenkins agents run on spot instances
memories.body: Agents disappear when spot capacity is reclaimed.

memories.name: rabbitmq-memory-alarm
memories.description: RabbitMQ memory alarm blocks publishers
memories.body: vm_memory_high_watermark is 0.4.

memories.name: minio-healing
memories.description: MinIO healing after a disk swap takes hours
memories.body: Expect degraded reads during healing.

memories.name: consul-leader
memories.description: Consul leader elections after network blips
memories.body: Short leader loss is harmless.

memories.name: memcached-restarts
memories.description: memcached restarts empty the session store
memories.body: Users are logged out after a restart.

memories.name: sftp-uploads
memories.description: Partner SFTP uploads arrive at 06:00
memories.body: Disk spikes on sftp-01 at 06:00.

memories.name: gpu-nodes
memories.description: GPU nodes are tainted
memories.body: Pods need the gpu toleration.
